sentences.1: If the injustice is not part of the necessary friction of the machine of government, let it go, let it go: perchance it will wear smooth, certainly the machine will wear out.
sentences.2: If the injustice has a spring, or a pulley, or a rope, or a crank, exclusively for itself, then perhaps you may consider whether the remedy will not be worse than the evil; but if it is of such a nature that it requires you to be the agent of injustice to another, then, I say, break the law.
sentences.3: Let your life be a counter friction to stop the machine.
sentences.4: What I have to do is to see, at any rate, that I do not lend myself to the wrong which I condemn.
sentences.5: As for adopting the ways which the State has provided for remedying the evil, I know not of such ways.
sentences.6: They take too much time, and a man's life will be gone.

leftover: Sentence 1: “machine; let it go, let it go; perchance it will wear smooth; certainly” — Machine/friction imagery, commands, possible smoothing and certainty. a retains only the categorical wear-out forecast under the explicitly negative antecedent; no actual antecedent is asserted.

No breaking of law or acting unjustly is asserted.

Sentence 3: “Let your life be a counter friction; machine” — Imperative force and mechanical metaphor; b retains the explicitly stated purpose as a plan, without an actual friction event, a stated effect or an invented control link.

Sentence 4: “What I have to do is to see, at any rate, that I do not lend myself to the wrong which I condemn.” — Duty and intended avoidance, with self-lending image and condemnation attitude. It does not assert that the writer has actually avoided participation.

Sentence 5: “As for adopting; for remedying the evil; I know not of such ways” — Contemplated adoption, purpose and lack of knowledge; no actual adoption, effective remedy or objective absence of ways is asserted.
Sentence 6: “They take too much time, and a man's life will be gone.” — Excess duration and temporal claim that life will be gone by then. No present death or numeric deadline is asserted.
